hook: Your snake actors die on stage again and again, every fake death pays out, and they get back up.
loop: Set Troupers up to Play Dead, often cueing the deaths yourself.
Every fake death fires death effects and feeds one shared count.
Cash it in the fight, or permanently next turn through Curtain Calls.

growth.line: Fight deaths become permanent stats next turn via Curtain Calls; Hesketh and Ardea scale it late.

feel.early: Extra lives win cheap early fights.
feel.mid: Barnstormer and Wreath-Layer start real permanent growth.
feel.late: Scripted death cascades and Ardea's rave pay out big.

stars.why: A ham who plays dead at every scratch: cheap fuel for everything.
Three scripted deaths in order; Broken Heart drops the whole cast.
The critic: a big show means big permanent stats, a thin one feeds him.

card_short.u01: Play Dead: one extra life each fight.
card_short.u02: Play Dead; drops a Tail; Curtain Call grows its Tails.
card_short.u03: Troupers that play dead permanently gain +1/+1, four a fight.
card_short.u04: Back row: swaps in when a front Trouper plays dead.
card_short.u05: Gold for every 3 fake deaths last fight, max 2.
card_short.u06: Play Dead; at Start of Combat, trades hits with a neighbour.
card_short.u07: Plays dead when hit, three times; Curtain Call: +1/+1.
card_short.u08: Play Dead; Curtain Call gets you a Shed Skin.
card_short.u09: Enemies that knock a Trouper down lose Attack.
card_short.u10: Front-row Troupers get up at half Health, not 1.
card_short.u11: Your own effects can't kill your units; they play dead.
card_short.u12: Murders your lowest-Health unit; gains Attack per fake death.
card_short.u13: Gives you a free Heap Hatchling every turn.
card_short.u14: Dies three set deaths: buffs, poison, then everyone plays dead.
card_short.u15: Each fake death deals damage equal to deaths so far.
card_short.u16: Back row: doubles your units' own death effects.
card_short.u17: Play Dead grows each turn; Curtain Call buffs other Troupers.
card_short.u18: Play Dead; when wiped out, revives units that played dead.
card_short.u19: 5+ deaths: big permanent Trouper buffs; otherwise eats your smallest.
card_short.x01: Little Anguis's one-fight token; grows with his Curtain Calls.
card_short.x02: Item: gives any unit +2/+2 and Play Dead.

builds.name: The long run
builds.line: Barnstormer and Wreath-Layer, then Hesketh and Ardea: permanent snowball.

builds.name: Blood and thunder
builds.line: Cue Natrix's deaths at Start of Combat; Blood-and-Thunder cashes the cascade.

builds.name: The costume rack
builds.line: Shed Skins and Žaltys lend Play Dead to other tribes, like Oozes.

liked: Dame Natrix's three scripted deaths turn cueing order into a puzzle each fight.
One shared death count every card feeds; Ardea's rave-or-pan is a clear capstone.
worries: Blood-and-Thunder with Broken Heart and Old Crest: quadratic damage, capped only per throw.
Also watched: Ardea's rave maxing every fight, Matron speeding triples, Wreath-Layer early growth.
changed: Units renamed Troupers, so "Player" no longer means the person playing.
Dame Natrix's deaths go in a fixed order and can't loop.
Clearer wording: Anguis's Tails last one fight; the Villain can't murder himself.
verdict: A tribe for death-trigger scripters: your actors die on cue, every fake death pays, and they rise again.
